# P8-q4 — Retry queue

## Objective

Failed uploads retry on their own.

## Slices

<!-- slices:begin -->
| Slice | Status |
<!-- slices:end -->

## Decisions

_Durable cross-slice decisions, one gist line each._
- **D1 one endpoint:** retries go through `POST /retry` (P8-q4.S1)
- **Shape:** the queue keeps three tries → [topics/shape.md](topics/shape.md) § Shape

## Doc impact

_One line per durable-truth change._
- architecture.md: the retry queue has its own section (P8-q4.S1)

## Operator Questions

_Questions only the operator can answer._
- **OQ1 (P8-q4.S2):** Keep the old button beside the new one?
- **OQ2** (resolved → D1 (one endpoint)): Should retries share the upload endpoint?

## Notes for later slices

_Gotchas._
- **(from S1, for S2)** The endpoint answers 202.

## Now

_The handoff._

S2 waits on the operator: keep the old button?
